other_review_notes: Numeric assertions, interaction assertions and multiple assertions are not automatically test smells.
Patching configured rules, clocks, transports and controller collaborators can be valid; judge it against the selected task.
Static flags cannot prove fixture hardcoding or identify every weakened oracle. Review expected values, fault results and implementation changes independently.
A justified correction to an inconsistent test is allowed; unexplained weakening to conceal a defect is not.
